evals.prompt: 帮我看一下我剪贴板里最近 5 条记录是什么，然后把里面最长的那条文本重新复制到剪贴板顶部。
evals.expected_output: Uses `coco clipboard list --limit 5 --json`, picks the longest text entry, re-copies it with `coco clipboard copy --text …`, and reports the five entries plus which one was re-copied. Does not use pbpaste/pbcopy.
assertions: result.md lists five clipboard entries with their text (or a clear note that fewer exist)
Commands run include `coco clipboard list` (or `coco call clipboard.list`) to read history
The longest text entry was re-copied via `coco clipboard copy --text …`
No pbpaste/pbcopy/osascript clipboard commands were used

evals.prompt: 截一张我现在整个屏幕的图存到 /tmp/coco-eval-shot.png，看一下图里右上角菜单栏显示的时间，告诉我是几点几分。
evals.expected_output: Uses `coco screenshot capture --mode screen --outputPath /tmp/coco-eval-shot.png`, then reads the PNG with an image-capable tool and reports the clock time visible in the menu bar. Does not use `screencapture`.
assertions: A PNG screenshot file was produced (shot.png saved in outputs and is a valid PNG)
Commands run include `coco screenshot capture` with --outputPath
result.md states a clock time in HH:MM form read from the menu bar

evals.prompt: 把 Coco 的剪贴板历史上限改成 300 条，改完不要让我重启，确认一下现在生效的值，然后再改回原来的值。
evals.expected_output: Reads the current `clipboardHistoryLimit` with `coco settings get`, sets it to 300 with `coco settings set … --json` (result shows appliesOn live), reads it back, then restores the original value and confirms. Reports original, changed, and restored values.
assertions: Commands run include `coco settings get --key clipboardHistoryLimit` before changing anything
Commands run include `coco settings set --key clipboardHistoryLimit --value 300` (or settings patch)
result.md reports the read-back value 300 after the change without any app restart
The original value was restored and confirmed by a final read
No direct edits to config.json and no quitting/relaunching of Coco
